get_character.description: Get a single character by their API id, the UUID any list or search action returns as 'id'. Searching by name first is the usual way to find that id.
get_character.name: get_character

parameters.description: The character's API id, such as '9e3f7ce4-b9a7-4244-b709-dae5c1f1d4a8' (Harry Potter). Read it off the 'id' field of a list or search result.
parameters.name: character_id

actor.description: The actor who played the character in the films, or empty when none.

alive.description: False for a character who has died in the story.

alternate_actors.description: Other actors who played the character.

alternate_names.description: Other names the character goes by, e.g. 'The Chosen One'.

ancestry.description: The character's blood status, e.g. 'pure-blood', 'half-blood', 'muggleborn' or 'muggle', or empty when not recorded.

dateOfBirth.description: The character's date of birth as DD-MM-YYYY, or null for most characters, whose birthday is not recorded.

eyeColour.description: The character's eye colour, or empty when not recorded.

gender.description: 'male' or 'female', or empty when not recorded.

hairColour.description: The character's hair colour, or empty when not recorded.

hogwartsStaff.description: True for a member of the Hogwarts staff.

house.description: The character's Hogwarts house, e.g. 'Gryffindor', or empty for a character in no house.

id.description: The character's API id, a UUID such as '9e3f7ce4-b9a7-4244-b709-dae5c1f1d4a8'. Get a character takes it.

image.description: A link to the character's portrait, or empty for the many who have none.

patronus.description: The character's patronus, e.g. 'stag', or empty when none.

wand.description: The character's wand. Its parts are empty when not recorded.

core.description: The wand's core, e.g. 'phoenix tail feather', or empty.

length.description: The wand's length in inches, or null when not recorded.

wood.description: The wand's wood, e.g. 'holly', or empty.

wizard.description: True for a witch or wizard, false for anyone else.

yearOfBirth.description: The year the character was born, or null when not recorded.

list_characters.description: List every character in the Harry Potter API: witches, wizards, muggles, ghosts, and magical creatures. Each record has room for their house, species, ancestry, patronus, wand, the actor who played them, and a portrait URL, though most characters have only some of these recorded. Use Limit and Offset to take a slice of the 400+ records.
list_characters.name: list_characters

parameters.description: How many records to return at most (defaults to all of them). The API sends the whole collection in one response, so this trims it afterwards.

parameters.description: How many records to skip before returning any (defaults to none). Pair it with Limit to walk a large collection a chunk at a time.

description: Look up characters and spells from the wizarding world using the free, keyless Harry Potter API (HP-API): search or page through 400+ characters with their house, species, ancestry, patronus, wand, and the actor who played them, narrow to Hogwarts students, staff, or a single house, search 70+ spells by incantation or by what they do, and pick a random character or spell. No account or API key required. Disclaimer: this is an independent integration with the community-run HP-API (hp-api.onrender.com). It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by J.K. Rowling, Warner Bros., or Pottermore; Harry Potter and all related names, characters, and trademarks are the property of their respective owners.
